legs: Single continuous camera move, no cuts. Dozens of tiny glowing embers drift up gently and slowly from the campfire, scattered and floating like fireflies; the camera tilts up and rises softly with the drifting embers into a deep night sky full of stars and the Milky Way, the small warm lights of the village far below beside the dark lake. Soft natural embers, no streaks, no fireworks, no rockets, no single beam.
